verdict.rationale: Gemini can ingest user data (docs, spreadsheets, code repos, Gmail, Drive, notebooks) and generate insights, summaries, and suggestions from it, including Deep Research pulling from personal sources, Notebooks for project-based analysis, and Daily Brief personalized digests; independent hands-on comments corroborate strong performance on large data analysis (e.g., codebase navigation, meeting transcript summarization). missing for 10: no independent benchmark specifically validating 'insights from personal/uploaded data' quality beyond anecdotal HN comments, and some community reports note accuracy issues in adjacent tasks (bounding boxes, some benchmarks) that add minor doubt.
